title: Traces of functions in Besov spaces in Gibbs environment
summary: This paper investigates the traces of functions belonging to the inhomogeneous Besov spaces B $ξ$ p,q , where $ξ$ is a product of capacities defined as powers of Gibbs measures. We first establish that the traces of functions in B $ξ$ p,q along affine hyperplanes belong to another inhomogeneous Besov space. Furthermore, we derive an upper bound for the singularity spectrum of the traces of all functions in B $ξ$ $\infty$,q .
